description.p: Nuvasha Launcher keeps Minecraft installations separate, so each instance can have its own version, loader, Java runtime, settings, mods, and worlds.
Browse Modrinth to install modpacks, mods, resource packs, and shaders. Local .mrpack files can be imported and exported, with downloads checked before they are installed.
The launcher supports vanilla Minecraft and the Fabric, Quilt, Forge, and NeoForge loaders. It can use Microsoft or offline accounts, and includes account-specific skins and capes.
Instances can be duplicated, moved, renamed, exported, and removed independently. Nuvasha Launcher is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita for Linux and is also available as a Flatpak.

Account records now use the desktop Secret Service, preserving offline and Microsoft identities, tokens, cosmetics, and active-account state. This release also improves account persistence tests, headless test handling, and sanitizer cleanup.
Improved sign-in, content navigation, instance version handling, and skin previews. This release also strengthens archive safety, download cleanup, Java discovery, and test coverage.
